content.text:
**Finding: missing (medium) — no post-termination transition assistance or data return.**

- § 3.5 *Effect of Termination* covers only accrued charges; no exit, export, or deletion mechanic exists anywhere (no hits for "transition", "delete"; "return" appears only in the IP indemnity and signature-block context).
- § 11.6 assigns Content responsibility to us but gives no retrieval right; § 14.2 survives § 3.5 as drafted, which adds nothing.
- Because there is no data return right at all, this sits in walk-away territory rather than at the fallback.

Redline validated (ok:true): a new § 3.5.1 requiring IBM to provide up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and thereafter delete and certify deletion — with the 90-day assistance fallback flagged in the comment.
